prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: All six target and control q records have positive printed convergence, no routine error and DONE. Fine full stress reaches .750 GPa despite only −.075 GPa mean pressure; Tc radioactivity, hydrogen retention/anharmonicity and relativistic/magnetic model sensitivity are concrete counterrisks.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: The exact source neutral zero-applied-pressure model has positive Γ optical compression intervals and no negative retained sampled path value for target and selected control. Coarse/fine force and full stress, relaxation warnings and every q record are retained. These finite observations do not prove full-BZ or thermodynamic hull stability.

counterevidence.scope: This frozen alternative has both higher coupling and higher source-model Tc than the target; the selected-control advantage does not extend to every alternative.

proposed_contribution.intervention: Re→Tc on the frozen hydride metal role raises weighted ωlog by 7.89–9.43% with mixed λ −.0170…+.0769. The hydrogen content and matched roles are retained, but metal chemistry, isotope mass and equilibrium metric are coupled.
proposed_contribution.next_action: Inspect the saved H-versus-metal-resolved spectral contribution and exact source PP role metadata, then resolve the fine anisotropic strain sensitivity. If the log-moment advantage comes from an anharmonic unstable H branch, the route interpretation is falsified.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
